en.headline: Observatory maintains Red Fire Danger Warning as risk remains extreme
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 6am on Friday, advising the public to take extra fire precautions amid dry conditions.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory has the Red Fire Danger Warning in force, indicating that the fire risk is extreme. The warning was issued at 6am on Friday and remains in effect.

The Observatory advises the public to be extra alert and to ensure necessary fire precautions are taken, particularly in dry weather. A Strong Monsoon Signal that had been in force earlier was cancelled at 12:45pm.
No other major weather warnings are currently reported in force for the territory.

zh.headline: 天文台維持紅色火災危險警告 火險極高
zh.dek: 香港天文台周五上午6時發出警告，提醒市民在乾燥天氣下特別提高警覺並採取防火措施。
body: 香港天文台現正維持紅色火災危險警告，表示火災危險性極高。警告於周五上午6時發出，至今仍然生效。
天文台提醒市民應特別提高警覺，並確保採取適當的防火措施，尤其在乾燥的天氣下。較早時發出的強烈季候風信號已於下午12時45分取消。
目前沒有其他主要天氣警告生效。
